constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.

Backend remains single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Changing any non-image content (training schedule, exercise library entries, calculators, nutrition copy, WhatsApp behavior).
Adding new sections or new functionality unrelated to photo replacement.
Implementing external image hosting or a CMS/gallery manager.
